existing_platform_evidence.finding: StaffordOS is the internal operating system, governance system, operational memory, and AI orchestration layer.
StaffordOS is the control plane; Abando is a product engine; no UI or state-mutation merging is allowed.
Business lifecycle spans marketing, leads, qualification, routing, sales, delivery, payment, proof, customer success, referral, and Abando expansion.
/operator remains runtime-canonical and /os should become canonical incrementally after parity.
Operator-facing language must answer what happened, why it matters, what to do, what blocks progress, what happens next, and what proves completion.
/os/capabilities links to current /operator routes without duplicating data, actions, loaders, or business logic.
Memory is explicit, typed, domain-scoped, source-aware, and must not mix family/private memory with business execution unless explicitly linked.
Local S007 models include StaffordosOperator, StaffordosOperatorRole, StaffordosOperatorSession, StaffordosOperatorEvent, and StaffordosExecutionGrant.
personal_os is documented as a future/not-started scope, not an implemented runtime.

evidence_gaps: No implemented StaffordOS media library, watching, creation, upload, or sharing runtime found.
No general workspace membership schema found.
No global workspace context middleware found.
No cross-workspace search, notification, memory, or agent policy engine found.

recommended_workspace_model.abando: first-class Business product workspace lens with API-only product-engine boundary

rules: Business data is private to the owner unless explicitly shared.
Professional data is private to the owner.
Personal data is owner-private unless explicitly shared.
Workspace membership and capability permission are separate.
A shared identity system does not imply shared data access.
AI agents inherit active user, workspace, role, permission, policy, memory, search, and notification boundaries.
Cross-workspace actions require explicit owner authorization.

roles.actions: prepare and approve owner-level actions; manage membership and capabilities
roles.prohibited_access: no bypass of payment, execution, legal, or external-provider authority

roles.actions: prepare and execute permitted business actions
roles.prohibited_access: requires approval for irreversible, financial, customer-facing, or production actions
no owner settings, Personal, Professional, unrelated customer, or security access
no broad customer list, finance, platform settings, or retained access after expiration

roles.actions: prepare, decide, and approve personal professional actions
roles.prohibited_access: external submission and employer data reuse require explicit owner action
no Business, Professional, owner-private Personal, security, or billing access unless separately granted
cannot change security, broad sharing, deletion policy, or owner-private records

roles.actions: create or watch approved items; participate in training
roles.prohibited_access: no unrestricted sharing, purchases, external publishing, security changes, or private browsing
no library browsing, resharing, deletion, or cross-workspace visibility

roles.actions: practice selected creation or operating workflows
roles.prohibited_access: no production, customer, financial, infrastructure, or private data access

roles.actions: create, edit, or prepare media within policy
roles.prohibited_access: external publishing, asset reuse, and deletion require assigned authority
no mutation, sharing, export, or approval authority

workspace_context_model.purpose: Prevent cross-workspace data, memory, search, notification, media, and agent leaks.

canonical_decision_model.question: What should this person do next in this workspace?

entities.OBJECTIVE: A measurable or observable result that advances the mission.
entities.ACTION: What the person or approved agent can do next.
entities.RISK: What could go wrong or what may be lost.
entities.DECISION: What was chosen, why, by whom, and under what authority.
entities.LEARNING: What StaffordOS should retain for future decisions.

priority_model.principle: Governed workspace-aware priority, not one universal AI score.

professional_workspace_boundary.mode_transition_rule: Same workspace, changed active mode, continuous private history.
strict_boundaries: Professional information is owner-private by default.
Applications, compensation, interview notes, employer feedback, and performance information do not enter Stafford Media automatically.
AI may organize and prepare but may not invent experience, credentials, accomplishments, feedback, or commitments.
Employer-confidential information must not be reused externally without explicit authority.
External communication and application submission require explicit owner approval.

business_shopifixer_abando_model.shopifixer: Business product/service lens with merchant, audit, packet, payment, execution, proof, and customer-success boundaries
business_shopifixer_abando_model.abando: Business product lens with API-only product-engine boundary

rebuild_risk_assessment.condition: No full rebuild is required if workspace context and capability-scoped boundaries are added before real multi-workspace data, search, notifications, and AI actions.

required_architectural_adjustments: Add workspace metadata to capability architecture before adding more /os pages.
Introduce a read-only workspace switcher foundation before Personal, Professional, Family, or invited-member surfaces.
Define a canonical workspace context contract before global search, notifications, memory retrieval, or AI actions become cross-workspace.
Extend NextActionCard to include time or effort, approval needed, and completion proof.
Create a decision read model before AI-generated priority ranking.
Preserve /operator runtime authority until migrated capabilities reach parity.
Keep Abando API-bound and read-only until separate product-integration authority exists.
Treat Personal, Family, Media, Professional, and Learner features as planned until separate implementation missions.
